question: I attack with two Ahn-Crop Champions and exert both. Does each Champion untap the other?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: each Champion untaps the other.
expected.answer: If you attack with two Ahn-Crop Champions and exert both, each will untap the other.

whyHard: An exerted creature will not untap normally, so players think exerting both leaves both tapped.
